componentAssessments.population: Target is mature beef cows grazing pasture; no candidate currently passes the complete gate.
componentAssessments.target: Individual total DMI, measured or scientifically eligible estimate, kg DM/animal/day; forage plus supplement where applicable.

metrics.decision: NO_GO; no training or validation permitted for the original target
metrics.basis: No source simultaneously has retrieved records, compatible target/population, known units, group keys, reusable license, and defensible independent evaluation.

limitations: Open article access is not evidence that underlying individual data are public or reusable.
Dairy, yearling, feedlot, estimated non-total DMI, aggregate-only, and simulated cohorts do not satisfy this target.

BR-CORTE 2023 Eq. 2.6 remains available for conditional scenarios in its published growing-Zebu supplemented-pasture domain when ADG is supplied; it does not establish adult-cow individual-DMI accuracy.
This does not prevent equation-based simulation or progress on separate biomass, behavior, or ADG modules.

componentAssessments.population: Cool-season grass-legume pasture grazed by yearling beef cattle at one northeastern-US research farm; no animals are observed in this file.
componentAssessments.target: Pre-grazing forage mass (PGFM), kg/ha; paddock-time mean over available quadrats, paired with paddock-level pre-grazing height in cm.

metrics.selectedModel: height-only OLS selected on 13-fold 100 m-buffered Mendeley development CV
metrics.modelEvaluation: completed single-cohort external evaluation; not calibration or broad validation

limitations: Only eight paddocks recur over time; every split must preserve paddock groups.
Biomass and height are aligned only after the documented paddock-time aggregation.
The Mendeley sampling-point target and Dryad paddock-time quadrat mean are not identical sampling estimands.
All 24 above-Mendeley-height-support rows are MOB treatment; support status is confounded with management, so the large above-support error cannot be attributed to extrapolation alone.
The external bias is strongly positive even within height support; overall MAE is 2507.1 kg DM/ha and in-support MAE is 1659.2 kg DM/ha.
Temperate US pasture does not validate Brazilian tropical pasture predictions.
Not animal DMI, ADG, or full-engine evidence.

componentAssessments.population: 24 beef cattle across four breeds at two New Mexico ranches; sampled daylight sessions in summer/fall 2022.
componentAssessments.target: Human-reviewed minute-level behavior class (GR, RE, RU, WA) from a single motion-index predictor; 8,864 analysis rows after the predeclared duplicate/conflicting-label policy.

metrics.evaluation: nested animal-grouped diagnostic; six outer folds, no animal overlap
metrics.modelEvaluation: nested within-source exploratory evaluation; not external validation

previousStaticGroupedOof.interpretation: prior static grouped-OOF diagnostic; these values are not metrics for the nested-selected model

limitations: Breed is perfectly confounded with ranch/site in the documented source structure.
RE recall is low; the main confusion is resting versus ruminating.
Nested OOF results are exploratory within this source and reuse both ranches across outer folds; they do not establish performance at a new ranch.
Sampled sessions do not represent full-day activity budgets or whole-season behavior.
Behavior classification does not validate DMI consumption, ADG, BR-CORTE, or the full Riose engine.

componentAssessments.population: 18 housed finishing beef steers in the Precision Beef source cohort; source split holds animals 04, 10, and 11 for test.
componentAssessments.target: 90-second majority behavior class inferred from the RumiWatch halter; collar accelerometer summary features predict instrument-derived labels.

metrics.scoringRule: Exclude partial boundary windows, tied/invalid labels, nonfinite collar features, and either-stream counts below 800 of 900 nominal samples.
metrics.modelEvaluation: reproducible instrument-agreement diagnostic on the source-provided animal split; test animals have appeared in the associated publication and are not an independent literature-level holdout

limitations: The prediction target is a RumiWatch instrument-derived majority label, not video-confirmed human ground truth.

The primary paper states time alignment was verified but does not specify row pairing or clock-offset corrections; processing uses README-anchored shared wall-clock bins and must not be interpreted as proof of exact synchronization.
The cohort consists of housed finishing steers; it does not evaluate grazing behavior or transport to farms/ranches.
This behavior result does not measure DMI or ADG and does not validate BR-CORTE or the Riose engine.
Animals 04, 10, and 11 are the source-provided test split, not a newly collected or literature-independent holdout.

componentAssessments.target: Endpoint ADG = (final weight - initial weight) / grazing days, kg/head/day.

metrics.evaluation: leave-one-year-out internal development CV with matching identity proxies purged from training

limitations: This is internal CPER development evidence, not external transport or a final holdout.
Only five year blocks; nominal confidence or prediction-interval coverage is not justified.
One remaining pasture replicate per treatment; engine inputs omit observed forage, weather, breed, and supplementation.
Yearling-steer ADG does not validate adult-cow DMI or the full engine.

source.license: Zenodo metadata says CC BY 4.0; embedded README says CC BY-NC (conflict)

componentAssessments.population: 10 adult lactating Holstein cows with pasture access at ILVO, Belgium.
componentAssessments.target: Hourly counts of one-minute classifier outputs for grazing, ruminating, resting, and other activity; not human reference labels.

metrics.predictiveMetrics: not_available; no independent human reference outcomes in archive

limitations: The released outcomes are decision-tree predictions; raw IMU and human-reference labels are absent.
License conflict means commercial training is not cleared.
Source time zone is unspecified; preserve timestamps as naive local time.
